parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the access control instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NodeAutoEnter
parameters.description: Specifies whether the node automatically joins the cluster and starts providing services after being added or recovered.

parameters.name: NodeIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the monitored nodes when RemindUnit (object type) is set to NODE (node). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 50 nodes can be monitored by a single rule.

parameters.name: NodeRole
parameters.description:
To query the metrics of a read-only node in a cloud-native read/write splitting architecture instance, specify **READONLY** for this parameter along with the specific **NodeId**.
>  In other cases, you do not need to specify this parameter or you can specify **MASTER**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) in which the endpoint resides.
